name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor between them, or hold it in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, keep your back flat and take the handle with both hands.
Stand tall with the kettlebell hanging in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent and shoulders pulled back.
Push your hips straight back and slide the kettlebell down your legs, keeping it close to your body.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, with your back still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
coaching_cues: Hinge at the hips; the knees only bend slightly and stay in the same position
Keep the kettlebell close to your legs the whole way
Stop lowering when your back would start to round
